DhNmHhRd1z9zeGJ8HB8_Xg.zh: 南非今年截至9/22,累計報告22例確定病例,近期病例快速增加,以男性為主,主要分布於西開普省(Western Cape)18例,年齡介於23至50歲。當局持續加強監測與接觸者追蹤。 安哥拉今年9/23新增19例確定病例,自2024年11月中旬迄今年9/5,累計442例確定病例、2例死亡(致死率:0.45%),擴及11個省份。當局將加強監測、預防及診斷等防治措施,並提醒⺠眾出現相關症狀應立即就醫。
DhNmHhRd1z9zeGJ8HB8_Xg.en: South Africa had reported 22 confirmed mpox cases this year as of 22 September, with cases increasing rapidly in recent weeks. Most cases are male, with 18 in the Western Cape, and ages range from 23 to 50. Authorities continue to strengthen surveillance and contact tracing. Angola recorded 19 new confirmed cases on 23 September. From mid-November 2024 to 5 September this year, it has reported 442 confirmed cases and 2 deaths (case fatality rate: 0.45%), spread across 11 provinces. Authorities will strengthen prevention and control measures, including surveillance, prevention and diagnosis, and remind the public to seek medical care immediately if related symptoms appear.

dAT_vx9BRnU-7cTwcLwW-A.zh: 歐洲地區今年第38週,新冠肺炎陽性率(15%)上升,變異株以XFG佔74%為主;流感陽性率(5.3%)低於基線,以A(H3N2)型別為主;呼吸道融合病毒活動度低。  南非今年第38週,新冠肺炎陽性率(1.5%)維持低水平;流感陽性率(9%),近4週(第35‒38週)以B型佔64%為主;呼吸道融合病毒(RSV)陽性率(1.5%)低於流行閾,該國於9/28宣布RSV流行季於第34週結束,惟仍需採取預防措施,以減少呼吸道病毒傳播。
dAT_vx9BRnU-7cTwcLwW-A.en: In the European region in week 38 of this year, the COVID-19 test positivity rate (15%) rose, with variant XFG accounting for 74%; the influenza positivity rate (5.3%) was below baseline, mainly influenza A(H3N2); respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) activity was low. In South Africa in week 38, COVID-19 positivity (1.5%) remained at a low level; influenza positivity (9%) over the past four weeks (weeks 35–38) was mainly influenza B, at 64%; RSV positivity (1.5%) was below the epidemic threshold. On 28 September the country announced that its RSV season ended in week 34, but preventive measures are still needed to reduce the spread of respiratory viruses.

lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.zh: 南非今年截至8/16(第33週),累計報告3,891例確定病例,較上週增加144例,1-14歲兒童佔總病例數之70%,新增病例以西開普省38例為多,其次為林波波省30例及北開普省20例;疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為主要因素,1歲以下未接種疫苗比例從2017年12.1%上升至2026年36.3%,該國優先針對未接種疫苗或尚未完整接種之兒童進行補接種作業。 秘魯今年截至第33週報告1,747例確定病例,其中以普諾地區(1,264例)為多,由於病例數增加,該國衛生部發佈流行病學警報,針對醫療機構加強流行病學監測及早期發現,並在受影響地區採取防治措施。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/8(第31週),計17個國家/地區累積報告48,690例確定病例及51例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4倍,97%病例來自瓜地馬拉(31,140例)、墨西哥(12,479例)、美國(2,465例)及加拿大(1,114例),部分國家通報延遲,研判疫情可能低估。
lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.en: South Africa: as of 16 August this year (week 33), 3,891 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of 144 over the previous week; children aged 1–14 account for 70% of total cases. The largest numbers of new cases are in Western Cape (38), followed by Limpopo (30) and Northern Cape (20). Insufficient vaccination coverage is the main factor: the proportion of unvaccinated children under 1 year old rose from 12.1% in 2017 to 36.3% in 2026. The country is prioritising catch-up vaccination for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated children. Peru: as of week 33 this year, 1,747 confirmed cases have been reported, mainly in the Puno region (1,264 cases). Because case numbers are rising, the Ministry of Health has issued an epidemiological alert, strengthening surveillance and early detection in healthcare facilities and taking control measures in affected areas. Americas regional update: as of 8 August this year (week 31), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 48,690 confirmed cases and 51 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about four times the number in the same period last year; 97% of cases came from Guatemala (31,140), Mexico (12,479), the United States (2,465) and Canada (1,114). Because some countries reported with delays, the outbreak is likely underestimated.

KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.zh: 非洲區自2025年初迄今年3/1,阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞和南非8國共通報超過29,000 例疑病例,其中1,420例死亡(CFR:4.9%),其中 752例經實驗確定病例,主要集中於日(313例)、奈及利亞(211例)及南非(93例)。WHO評估疫情有進一步地理擴散的潛力、致死率偏高、控制疫情的資源(疫苗與DAT)嚴重不足、且監測與實驗室系統受限, 該區傳播風險為中,全球風險為低。 奈及利亞日(Niger)州疫情呈多點擴散,今年截至8月,累計報告124例確定病例,17例死亡(CFR:13.7%),高於該國同期平均(2.3%),病例主要為未接種疫苗之兒童。因疫苗覆蓋率低,以及跨區人口流動及疫苗猶豫等因素,該國刻正推動逐戶接種疫苗及與宗教領袖合作等措施,以防止疫情擴散。 塞內加爾今年5至8月進行病歷回溯調查(醫療機構病歷),有591 例曾出現喉嚨痛、扁桃腺炎等症狀,其中7例為確定病例,主要集中於東部凱杜古(Kedougou)及薩拉亞(Saraya)地區,該國已於受影響區加強疫苗補接種與主動監測,以防止疫情向周邊擴散。
KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.en: From early 2025 to 1 March this year, eight countries in the African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) reported more than 29,000 suspected cases, of which 1,420 died (CFR 4.9%). 752 cases were laboratory-confirmed, mainly in Niger (313), Nigeria (211) and South Africa (93). WHO assesses that the outbreak has potential for further geographic spread and a high case fatality rate, that control resources (vaccines and diphtheria antitoxin, DAT) are severely insufficient, and that surveillance and laboratory systems are limited; the transmission risk in the region is moderate, and the global risk is low. In Niger State, Nigeria, the outbreak has spread across multiple points: as of August this year, 124 confirmed cases and 17 deaths had been cumulatively reported (CFR 13.7%), higher than the country's average for the same period (2.3%); most cases were unvaccinated children. Owing to low vaccine coverage, cross-regional population movement and vaccine hesitancy, the country is pursuing door-to-door vaccination and cooperation with religious leaders to prevent further spread. In Senegal, a retrospective review of medical records from May to August this year identified 591 cases with symptoms such as sore throat and tonsillitis, of which 7 were confirmed, mainly in the eastern Kédougou and Saraya areas. Senegal has strengthened catch-up vaccination and active surveillance in affected areas to prevent spread to surrounding areas.

ZJvhiIJmqVoUsnHJhrSh4Q.zh: 南非開普敦針對沿岸的南非海豹發布狂犬病警告,自2年前檢測迄今,已累計逾90件海豹感染案例,且2月曾在豪特灣發生發病海豹攻擊遊客事件。當局已為獸醫等高風險人員施打暴露前疫苗,並於救援船隻配備暴露後預防醫療包,加強防疫與應變能力。
ZJvhiIJmqVoUsnHJhrSh4Q.en: Cape Town has issued a rabies warning regarding Cape fur seals along its coastline. Since testing began two years ago, more than 90 seal infection cases have been recorded cumulatively. In February, a seal with symptoms attacked a tourist in Hout Bay. Authorities have given pre-exposure vaccination to high-risk personnel, including veterinarians, and equipped rescue vessels with post-exposure prophylaxis medical kits to strengthen disease prevention and response capacity.

ntGQB584jFhG2l4dPlDOjQ.zh: WHO非洲區自去(2025)年截至今年3/1共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2.9萬例疑病例,其中1.8萬例為確定病例,1,420例死亡,752例經實驗室確診,相較WHO於去年10月進行之風險評估,疑病例新增約1.1萬例,死亡人數新增529例,奈及利亞為該區疑及死亡病例最多國家,佔5成以上,病患以5-14歲兒童年齡層及女性為主。WHO考量該區每週新增病例數整體呈下降趨勢且多數國家已啟動應變工作,惟仍有診斷試劑/檢驗/藥物缺乏等問題,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險由「高」調整為「中」,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為「低」,惟仍須留意至非洲區旅遊之罹病風險。
ntGQB584jFhG2l4dPlDOjQ.en: The WHO African Region reported more than 29,000 suspected cases from last year through 1 March this year across eight countries (Algeria, Chad, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria, Mali and South Africa). Of these, 18,000 were classified as confirmed cases, 1,420 died, and 752 were laboratory-confirmed. Compared with the WHO risk assessment conducted in October last year, suspected cases increased by about 11,000 and deaths by 529. Nigeria accounted for more than half of the suspected and fatal cases in the region, and patients were mainly children aged 5–14 years and females. WHO noted that weekly new cases in the region are generally declining and most countries have activated response operations, but shortages of diagnostic tests, laboratory capacity and drugs persist. WHO has therefore revised the overall public health risk for the African Region from 'high' to 'moderate'. Most countries outside Africa have robust immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is assessed as 'low'; however, the risk of disease for travellers to the African Region should still be noted.

sMGkDs3L4oEuBERegJcmwA.zh: 南非東部姆普馬蘭加省疫情明顯上升,於1月份報告314例病例,高於去年同期69例,由於洪水導致病媒蚊孳生且適逢流行季,疫情可能持續至3-4月,當局呼籲加強預防措施。
sMGkDs3L4oEuBERegJcmwA.en: Malaria in Mpumalanga Province in eastern South Africa has risen markedly, with 314 cases reported in January, 69 more than the same period last year. Flooding has led to mosquito breeding, and this coincides with the epidemic season. The outbreak may continue until March–April, and authorities call for strengthened prevention measures.

dQPj3jT_gUJp32yDfhXkjw.zh: 南非報告自2024年截至今年1/18累計報告91例確定病例,19例疑或確定死亡病例, 21例(23%)病例為12歲及以下兒童,分布以西南部西開普省67例為多。當局已針對密切接觸者進行採檢、隔離、提供預防性藥物及預防接種等措施。
dQPj3jT_gUJp32yDfhXkjw.en: From 2024 to 18 January this year, South Africa reported 91 confirmed cases and 19 suspected or confirmed deaths. 21 cases (23%) were children aged 12 and under. Most cases were in the Western Cape province in the southwest, with 67 cases. Authorities have carried out sampling and isolation of close contacts, provided prophylactic medication, and carried out vaccination.

ByHqodPAO0_F5zCuvlXmjQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第45週(11/3-9)全球陽性率6.15%,僅非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第46週(11/10-16)定醫平均報告數1.91,較近2週下降,病患分布以北海道、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 歐洲疫情下降,第46週整體陽性率為6.1%,距第38週高峰(陽性率24.4%)已明顯下降,以變異株XFG占比最高(66%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12%)。 加拿大疫情下降,第46週陽性率降至6.4%,且低於近2年同期,65歲以上病患占6成,變異株XFG占比最高。 南非疫情上升,第46週私立機構陽性率約20%,符合低度流行閾,死亡率亦上升,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,惟非洲區署呈上升;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ByHqodPAO0_F5zCuvlXmjQ.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 45 of 2025 (3–9 November) was 6.15%; only the African Region saw an increase in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 46 (10–16 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 1.91, lower than in the previous two weeks. Cases are concentrated in Hokkaido and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Europe: The outbreak is declining. The overall positivity rate in week 46 was 6.1%, markedly lower than the week 38 peak of 24.4%; the variant XFG has the highest share (66%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). Canada: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate fell to 6.4% in week 46, lower than the same period in the past two years; patients aged 65 and over account for 60%, and the variant XFG has the highest share. South Africa: The outbreak is rising. In week 46, the positivity rate at private facilities was about 20%, meeting the low-level epidemic threshold, and mortality has also risen; the variant XFG has the highest share. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but the African Region is rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.zh: WHO非洲區共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2萬例疑病例,其中9,864 例經實驗室確診,1,252例死亡,多數病患為兒童及青少年族群。受限於診斷試劑/檢驗/臨床照護能力不足及白喉抗毒素(DAT)供應短缺等因素,嚴重影響疫情防治工作。WHO考量非洲區疫情可能持續擴散,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險為高,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為低。
bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.en: Eight countries in the WHO African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) have cumulatively reported more than 20,000 suspected cases, of which 9,864 were laboratory-confirmed and 1,252 died. Most patients are children and adolescents. Insufficient diagnostic reagents, testing and clinical care capacity, and shortages of diphtheria antitoxin (DAT) are seriously hindering outbreak prevention and control. WHO considers that the outbreak in the African Region may continue to spread, and assesses the overall public health risk in the African Region as high. Most countries outside the African Region have well-established immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is low.

dAEGylmMjxbtiPA8rEyibg.zh: 美國西維吉亞州今年截至11/6累計報告126例確定病例,主要分布於西部,其中28例須住院治療,病患年齡中位數為12歲,其中23例為12 個月以下嬰兒,當局已公布相關指引,另表示疫情每隔 3-5 年就會出現週期性高峰,流行病例已從嬰兒轉為青少年和成人,評估因其疫苗免疫力減弱所致。 南非今年截至10月累計報告483例確診病例,主要分布於豪登省和西開普省,其中50%為5歲以下兒童,25%為6個月齡以下嬰兒,當局已提醒醫生針對嬰兒及未接種疫苗者提高診斷警覺,並持續監測疫情。
dAEGylmMjxbtiPA8rEyibg.en: West Virginia, US: As of 6 November this year, 126 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in the western part of the state, and 28 required hospitalization. The median patient age is 12 years, and 23 cases were infants under 12 months old. Authorities have published relevant guidance and state that outbreaks peak cyclically every three to five years. Epidemic cases have shifted from infants to adolescents and adults, which is assessed to be due to waning vaccine-induced immunity. South Africa: As of October this year, 483 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Gauteng and Western Cape provinces. Of these, 50% were children under 5 years old and 25% were infants under 6 months old. Authorities have reminded doctors to maintain heightened diagnostic vigilance for infants and unvaccinated people, and continue to monitor the outbreak.

fS96YJqQP69SiX3z5mhA3g.zh: 南非共和國北部茨瓦內市(Tshwane)於11/3報告13例病例,病患年齡多小於15歲,當局正進行水質檢測,以釐清感染源;另該國每年約報告150例確定病例。
fS96YJqQP69SiX3z5mhA3g.en: Tshwane, a city in the north of the Republic of South Africa, reported 13 cases on 3 November; most patients are under 15 years old. Authorities are testing water quality to identify the source of infection. The country typically reports about 150 confirmed cases each year.

Ezx0x3GIDo_4Nz6wbsoo4Q.zh: 南非首都開普敦8/6報告某餐廳群聚疫情,累計報告46例疑病例,其中33例確診桿菌性痢疾或大腸桿菌感染(EIEC),分別為員工27人、顧客6人;另當局表示2022-24年累計報告437起食品中毒案件,未通報或調查不完整之案件仍多。
Ezx0x3GIDo_4Nz6wbsoo4Q.en: The South African capital, Cape Town, reported a restaurant cluster on 6 August. A total of 46 suspected cases were cumulatively reported, of which 33 were confirmed as shigellosis or enteroinvasive E. coli (EIEC) infection: 27 staff and 6 customers. Separately, authorities report that 437 food poisoning incidents were cumulatively reported during 2022–24, and many incidents remain unreported or incompletely investigated.

vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.zh: 以色列今年4月截至8/10累計報告410例,當局評估該國感染人數介於950-1,700人間,並報告22例住院,其中包含2名嬰幼兒重症案例,該國已啟動疫苗接種活動。 蒙古今年截至8/7累計報告逾1.3萬例,其中10例死亡,病例多為未接種疫苗之兒童,該國於2015-16年期間爆發疫情,報告140例死亡,多數為嬰幼兒。 韓國今年截至8/9累計報告68例,其中49例境外移入及19例與境外移入病例相關病例,病例數為去年同期1.4倍,感染國家以越南42例為多,餘有南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/蒙古,病例多為19歲以上成年人,過半數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不詳。 日本東京都病例數上升,今年截至8/7累計報告28例,超過去年全年病例數(10例),因連續假期將至,外出返鄉人潮增加,當局加強警戒。
vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.en: Israel: 410 cases have been reported since April this year, as of 10 August. Authorities estimate that the number of infected people in the country is between 950 and 1,700. A total of 22 cases were hospitalized, including two severe cases in infants and young children, and the country has launched a vaccination campaign. Mongolia: as of 7 August this year, more than 13,000 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 10 deaths; cases are mostly in unvaccinated children. Mongolia had an outbreak in 2015–16 that reported 140 deaths, most of them infants and young children. South Korea: as of 9 August this year, 68 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 49 were imported and 19 were linked to imported cases; case numbers are 1.4 times those of the same period last year. Most infections were acquired in Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from South Africa, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Italy and Mongolia. Most cases are adults aged 19 and over, and more than half were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Tokyo Metropolis, Japan: case numbers are rising; as of 7 August this year, 28 cases had been cumulatively reported, exceeding last year's full-year total of 10 cases. With the holiday period approaching and more people travelling out and returning home, authorities have increased vigilance.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.

Hq86C_GLBhMLVBQEvCuJpw.zh: 澳大利亞新南威爾斯州報告1例死亡病例,為50多歲男性,病患於數月前被受感染之蝙蝠咬傷並接受治療,於7/3死亡,為該州首例死亡病例,該國自1996年迄今已報告4例,當局已啟動疫情調查,並呼籲民眾避免接觸蝙蝠。 印度北方邦報告1例死亡病例,為22歲男性,病患1個月前曾被犬隻咬傷,且未接種疫苗,於6/26出現呼吸困難,28日死亡,當局已啟動衛教宣導及疫苗接種服務。 南非東部夸祖魯-納塔爾省報告1例死亡病例,為32歲男性,曾於3月被犬隻咬傷,且未接種疫苗,於5/30死亡;該省去(2024)年報告3例,當局已啟動犬/貓隻疫苗接種服務。南非病例數前3名省份為夸祖魯-納塔爾、東開普及林波波省。
Hq86C_GLBhMLVBQEvCuJpw.en: New South Wales, Australia, reported one death, a man in his 50s who had been bitten months earlier by an infected bat and had received treatment. He died on 3 July, the state's first such death. Australia has reported 4 cases since 1996. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and urge the public to avoid contact with bats. Uttar Pradesh, India, reported one death, a 22-year-old man who had been bitten by a dog one month earlier and was unvaccinated. He developed breathing difficulties on 26 June and died on 28 June. Authorities have launched health education and vaccination services. KwaZulu-Natal Province in eastern South Africa reported one death, a 32-year-old man who was bitten by a dog in March and was unvaccinated. He died on 30 May. The province reported 3 cases last year, and dog and cat vaccination services have been launched. The three provinces with the most cases in South Africa are KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape and Limpopo.

8iE8QRH5_8cBcFXa-kJPZA.zh: 南非豪登省於2/24報告該國首次I型病例,共3例個案,指標案例為30歲男性,具非洲Ib型疫區旅遊史,1/24發病,27日就醫,初誤診為皰疹,並以抗生素治療,後於2/6採檢,21日確診為I型。當局匡列7名接觸者後發現2例個案,其中,案2為案1伴侶,27歲女性;案3為案1朋友,30歲男性。WHO評估跨境風險持續存在,呼籲需加強醫護人員專業訓練,與民眾風險溝通,並加強監測。
8iE8QRH5_8cBcFXa-kJPZA.en: Gauteng Province, South Africa, reported on 24 February the country's first clade I cases: 3 cases in total. The index case is a 30-year-old man with a travel history to an African clade Ib outbreak area. He developed symptoms on 24 January and sought care on 27 January; he was initially misdiagnosed as herpes and treated with antibiotics. Samples were taken on 6 February, and clade I was confirmed on 21 February. After 7 contacts were listed, 2 more cases were found: case 2, the index case's partner, a 27-year-old woman; and case 3, the index case's friend, a 30-year-old man. WHO assesses that cross-border risk persists and calls for strengthened professional training for healthcare workers, risk communication with the public, and enhanced surveillance.

e8dKWi8qaksZ_WzZN97YKQ.zh: 南非2/21新增首3例1b型病例,指標病例為30歲男性,2/21確診,具烏干達旅遊史,其餘2例為匡列時發現,為案1接觸者,分別為30歲男性與27歲女性,目前已漸康復並居家隔離中,另顯示可能有潛在的社區傳播鏈。該國上次報告案例為2024年9月,皆為II型病例。自2024年5月截至2025/2/28已累計28例病例,其中3例死亡。
e8dKWi8qaksZ_WzZN97YKQ.en: On 21 February South Africa reported the first 3 clade Ib cases. The index case is a 30-year-old man, confirmed on 21 February, with a travel history to Uganda. The other 2 cases were found during contact tracing: contacts of case 1, a 30-year-old man and a 27-year-old woman. They are gradually recovering and are isolating at home. This suggests a possible chain of undetected community transmission. The country's previous reported cases were in September 2024, all clade II. From May 2024 to 28 February 2025, 28 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 3 deaths.
